name: Frederic Chopin
summary: Results-driven DevOps Engineer with 5+ years of experience in automating and optimizing mission-critical deployments in AWS, GCP, and Azure. Skilled in managing CI/CD pipelines and ensuring high availability and performance of applications. Strong background in both development and operations.

description: Implemented CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins and GitLab CI, reducing deployment time by 30%.
Automated infrastructure provisioning and management using Terraform and Ansible.
Collaborated with development teams to improve application reliability and performance through monitoring and troubleshooting.
Assisted in the migration of legacy applications to cloud infrastructure (AWS and GCP).
Monitored system performance and user experience, providing reports to stakeholders.
Supported in the development of scripts for automated deployment.

extra_info.title: Projects
items: Lead the migration project of monolithic applications to microservices architecture on AWS.
Developed a custom CI/CD pipeline for a large-scale web application with automated testing.
